mEmail ID: ajaymit007@yahoo.com | Linkedin: www.linkedin.com/in/ajaykchaudhari | Location: Pune
SUMMARY
Product Owner with 13+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale product strategy, digital transformation,
and regulatory initiatives across Payments, Wholesale Banking, and Retail Banking domains. Proven expertise in
delivering complex payment solutions including Cross-Border Payments, ACH, Wire Transfers, SWIFT MT/MX
Messaging, ISO 20022 Migration, Clearing & Settlement, and Real-Time Payment ecosystems.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology, 2006-2010, from Uttar Pradesh Technical University, UP
CORE SKILLS
✓ Key Skills - Product Ownership & Product Strategy | SAFe Agile | Scrum | RTB | CTB | Product Roadmap |
Program Increment (PI) Planning | Business Analysis | Requirement Management | Epic | User Story Creation
& Acceptance Criteria | Product Backlog and Refinement | Product Demo | Stakeholder and Executive
Management | Cross-Functional Team Leadership | RAID Management | Risk Management
✓ Domain Expertise - Wholesale Banking | Issuer Services | Retail Banking | Payments - Cross-Border
Payments, Real-Time Payments (RTP), ACH & Wire Payments | ISO 20022 Migration & Transformation -
✓ Delivery & Transformation - End to End Product Delivery | UAT Coordination and Sign-off | Change
Management | Workflow Automation | Data Analysis and Reporting | KPI & Performance Metrics
✓ Business Transformation & Architecture -AS-IS / TO-BE Analysis | Target Operating Model (TOM) |
Business Process Mapping | Process Re-engineering | Business Capability Mapping | Process
Optimization | Transformation Roadmaps | Customer Journey Mapping | Gap Analysis | Operating
✓ Tools, Technology & Products - JIRA | Confluence | MS Visio | MS Office Suite | Generative AI | API
Integration | | JSON/XML payloads and Validations | SQL | Database | ERP | CRM | FINNONE | VMS |
SWIFT MT/MX Messaging | Clearing & Settlement | Fintech
Model Transformation
ODYSSEY| RET
ORGANIZATIONAL EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst
✓ Designed and implemented change management strategies that improve adoption rates and delivered
the enhance version of CRM application to various clients.
Virtusa Consulting Service Private Limited | Pune
1. Client – CITI Bank | Product Owner | (October 2025 to Till Now)
October2021-Present
Key Roles:
✓ Responsible for CITI Global Regulatory Event Tracking product ownership and strategy including defining
product vision, roadmap and strategic objectives.
✓ Actively participated in PI planning activities and all scrum ceremonies.
✓ Facilitating requirement workshops, peer discussion and gathering detailed requirements from multiple
stakeholders.
✓ Translating regulatory requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
✓ Generative AI Use Case Identification for RET Product.
✓ Responsible for backlog refinements and prioritization.
✓ Act as primary bridge between business stakeholders, development and delivery team.
✓ Collaborate closely with engineering team to remove critical blockers, and ensure timely delivery of features.
✓ Supporting UAT to ensure successful feature delivery.
✓ Coordinate with other POs, Scrum Masters, and the Release Train Engineer (RTE) across the Agile Release Train
(ART) to manage cross team dependencies mitigate the risks.
✓ Document and maintain product artifacts like Steer-co, RAID log etc.
✓ Tracking production issues, identify root cause and coordinating with support team for issue resolution.
✓ Tracking KPIs and accomplishments and delivery milestones.
✓ Strong exposure to both Change-the-Bank (CTB) and Run-the-Bank (RTB) operating models, with a sound
appreciation of production stability, operational controls, and risk management
✓ Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to
engage confidently with senior business stakeholders, technology leads, and external partners.
2. Client – HSBC | Agile Business Analyst | (October 2021 to October 2025)
Key Roles:
✓ Facilitated requirements workshops and prepared functional requirements documents, working closely
with Product, Business and Technology stakeholders.
✓ Gathered requirements and created user stories, use cases, process flows and mock-ups.
✓ Performed functional testing and facilitated UAT with business users; conducted walkthroughs and
supported SIT/UAT execution.
✓ Performed gap analysis and developed roadmaps for application enhancements and transformation
initiatives.
✓ Supported Target Operating Model (TOM) transformation for payment processing, defining future-state
process responsibilities, business/technology hand-offs, operational controls and system interactions
across payment initiation, processing, clearing and settlement.
✓ Conducted detailed AS-IS process analysis across cross-border payments, ACH, Wire, SWIFT and ISO
20022 payment flows, documenting current-state processes, business rules, system interactions, hand-offs
and operational pain points.
✓ Performed AS-IS vs. TO-BE gap analysis to identify process, system, data and operational gaps and
translated findings into business requirements, user stories and transformation initiatives.
✓ Designed and documented TO-BE process flows for payment migration and automation initiatives,
identifying process simplification opportunities, changes in system responsibilities and opportunities to
improve straight-through processing.
✓ Performed Business Capability Mapping for payment transformation initiatives, linking payment
capabilities across initiation, validation, processing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation and exception
management to supporting processes and technology components.
✓ Led requirements workshops for critical banking transformation projects including US Transtar Migration,
Cross-Border Payments, ACH, Wire, SWIFT, CT Account Automation, Repack Reporting, ISO 20022/SWIFT
Migration, DTCC and clearing-house initiatives.
Key Deliverables:
✓ Supported legacy-to-target platform transformation by analysing AS-IS processes, identifying functional and
operational gaps, defining TO-BE workflows and translating target-state requirements into business/user
stories while addressing customer, regulatory and compliance requirements.
Implemented US payment solutions covering ACH and Wire, along with ISO 20022-aligned corporate-action
messaging across HK, UK, US and Singapore.
✓ Led functional analysis for cross-border payment and cash-account automation, mapping AS-IS payment flows
and defining TO-BE workflows across SWIFT messaging, HUB-Hadoop integration and Odyssey, including
business rules, system interactions, exception handling and operational hand-offs.
Implemented cross-border payment flows involving MT103 and MT202 and supported cash-account
automation through HUB-Hadoop/Odyssey integration.
